# SIMULATED DOCUMENT: written for the OrbitFlow demo. It is not an operator's real policy.

## 1 Human oversight
Automated radio resource decisions remain reviewable by a human. Decisions that trade a legal limit against emergency service are referred to a person.

## 2 Record keeping
Every automated decision is logged with the inputs, the proposed action, the executed action, the rule applied and its evidence.

## 3 Signalling protection
Automated controllers must not suppress initial access signalling. Every cell receives SSB and system information broadcast within its configured maximum age.
